intended_object: The canonical preadditive structure on a non-preadditive abelian category (Freyd's construction). Subtraction is f - g = (f, g) ≫ σ, where σ is the cokernel of the diagonal; negation is -f = 0 - f; addition is f + g = f - (-g). Inferred from the docstring and the module.
explanation: The definition builds an AddCommGroup on each Hom-set from the operations defined in the same file (hasSub, hasNeg, hasAdd). Every group axiom comes from a lemma proved there. zero_add uses neg_neg, which works because 0 + f unfolds by definition to -(-f). Bilinearity of composition is given by add_comp and comp_add. This is the standard result that a non-preadditive abelian category is preadditive. It is stated at its natural generality: the construction needs exactly the non-preadditive abelian axioms and nothing more. Mathlib has no other declaration of this construction, so no counterpart is cited.
